description: Every one of the twelve is built from exactly one primitive: a small opaque-to-translucent square, sometimes left axis-aligned, sometimes tipped a few degrees, sometimes turned a full 45 degrees into a diamond. There is no line work, no curve, no texture, no second shape anywhere in the collection. The palette is monochrome and narrow -- roughly four or five steps from a warm bone/cream through two greys to near-black charcoal, on a flat near-black ground with a barely perceptible warm cast; there is no hue anywhere. The frame is used the same way in all twelve: a single centred island floating in a wide empty margin, never touching or crossing an edge, so every token is a vignette with a lot of dead ground around it. What differs between seeds is layout archetype, element scale and packing density: 9011, 9906 and 10980 are ruled grids of small squares in four or five rows; 9727, 10085, 10264 and 10622 are dense scattered clusters of mid-sized squares that overlap into lighter patches; 9369, 9548 and 10801 are tight stacks of very large squares that fuse into one pale amorphous slab with only the seams and a few dark corners readable; 10443 is a near-empty sprinkle of tiny grey squares and 9190 is a small curled comma of a dozen. Across the three conditions the whole mass does the same thing in each token: neutral is cohesive and evenly spread, stress thins and SPLITS it -- 9369 tears into a top and bottom half with a dark gap between, 9190 separates into two clusters, 9011 drops from seven columns to five and loses tone, 9548 has a bite taken out of its lower edge -- and recovery reassembles into something denser and creamier than neutral, with more white elements and a slightly jagged crown.
seenAt120: What survives is the archetype and the value mass, nothing else. The grids read as a banded field of dots, the dense clusters as a mottled grey clump, the big-square stacks as a single pale featureless lump with no internal structure, and 10443 nearly vanishes into a faint sprinkle. Individual square rotations, the diamond/square alternation and the overlap seams are all gone. Three of the twelve (9369, 9548, 10801) become close to interchangeable pale blobs at this size; the twelve read as maybe four or five distinguishable kinds rather than twelve.
